title_en: Amendment (IX) to the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en:
Article 1. One article is added after Article 37 of the Criminal Law as Article 37a: "Where a person is sentenced to criminal punishment for committing a crime by taking advantage of occupational convenience, or for committing a crime that violates specific obligations required by an occupation, the People's Court may, based on the circumstances of the crime and the need to prevent recidivism, prohibit him or her from engaging in the relevant occupation from the date of completion of the execution of the criminal punishment or the date of parole, for a period of three to five years.
"Where a person who is prohibited from engaging in the relevant occupation violates a decision made by the People's Court in accordance with the preceding paragraph, the public security organ shall impose a penalty according to law; if the circumstances are serious, the person shall be convicted and punished in accordance with Article 313 of this Law.
"Where other laws or administrative regulations have other prohibitive or restrictive provisions on engaging in the relevant occupation, such provisions shall prevail."

Article 2. Paragraph 1 of Article 50 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Where a death sentence with a two-year reprieve is imposed, during the period of the reprieve, if the person does not commit any intentional crime, upon the expiration of the two-year period, the sentence shall be commuted to life imprisonment; if the person has truly performed major meritorious service, upon the expiration of the two-year period, the sentence shall be commuted to twenty-five years of fixed-term imprisonment; if the person commits an intentional crime with flagrant circumstances, the death penalty shall be executed after being reported to and approved by the Supreme People's Court; if the death penalty is not executed for the intentional crime, the period of the reprieve shall be recalculated and reported to the Supreme People's Court for record."

Article 3. Article 53 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "A fine shall be paid in a lump sum or in installments within the period specified in the judgment. If the fine is not paid upon expiration of the period, enforcement shall be carried out. If a fine cannot be paid in full, the People's Court shall at any time discover that the person subject to enforcement has executable property, and shall pursue recovery promptly.
"If it is truly difficult to pay due to circumstances such as an irresistible disaster, the People's Court may, by ruling, permit an extension of the time for payment, or reduce or waive the fine as appropriate."

Article 4. A paragraph is added to Article 69 of the Criminal Law as paragraph 2: "Where among the several crimes, some are punishable by fixed-term imprisonment and some by criminal detention, the fixed-term imprisonment shall be executed. Where among the several crimes, some are punishable by fixed-term imprisonment and public surveillance, or by criminal detention and public surveillance, after the execution of the fixed-term imprisonment or criminal detention, the public surveillance shall still be executed."
The original paragraph 2 shall be paragraph 3.

Article 5. Article 120 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever organizes or leads a terrorist organization shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment, and shall also be sentenced to confiscation of property; whoever actively participates shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined; other participants shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights, and may also be fined.
"Whoever commits the crime mentioned in the preceding paragraph and also commits crimes such as homicide, explosion, or kidnapping shall be punished in accordance with the provisions on combined punishment for several crimes."

Article 6. Article 120a of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever provides financial support to a terrorist organization or to an individual who commits a terrorist activity, or provides financial support to terrorist training, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years, and shall also be fined or have property confiscated.
"Whoever recruits or transports personnel for a terrorist organization, for committing terrorist activities, or for terrorist training shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
"Where a unit commits the crimes described in the preceding two paragraphs, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible for the crime shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 1."

Article 7. Five articles are added after Article 120a of the Criminal Law as Articles 120b, 120c, 120d, 120e, and 120f:
"Article 120b. Whoever commits any of the following acts shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years, and shall also be fined or have property confiscated:
"(1) preparing weapons, dangerous articles, or other tools for committing terrorist activities;
"(2) organizing terrorist training or actively participating in terrorist training;
"(3) contacting a foreign terrorist organization or persons for committing terrorist activities;
"(4) making plans or other preparations for committing terrorist activities.
"If the act described in the preceding paragraph also constitutes another crime, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions on the heavier punishment.
"Article 120c. Whoever produces or disseminates books, audio or video materials, or other articles that advocate terrorism or extremism, or advocates terrorism or extremism through lectures or by publishing information, or incites the commission of terrorist activities, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years, and shall also be fined or have property confiscated.
"Article 120d. Whoever uses extremism to incite or coerce the masses to disrupt the implementation of the systems of marriage, judicature, education, and social management established by the laws of the State shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are especially serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than seven years, and shall also be fined or have property confiscated.
"Article 120e. Whoever compels another person to wear or display clothing or symbols that advocate terrorism or extremism in a public place by means of violence, coercion, etc., shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall also be fined.
"Article 120f. Whoever illegally holds books, audio or video materials, or other articles that advocate terrorism or extremism, knowing that such items advocate terrorism or extremism, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall be fined or shall be fined only."

Article 9. Paragraph 1 of Article 151 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever smuggles weapons, ammunition, nuclear materials, or counterfeit currency shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than seven years, and shall also be fined or have property confiscated; if the circumstances are especially serious, the offender shall be sentenced to life imprisonment and shall also have property confiscated; if the circumstances are relatively minor, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined."

Article 10. Paragraph 1 of Article 164 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever gives property to an employee of a company, enterprise, or other unit for the purpose of seeking illegitimate benefits, if the amount is relatively large, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined; if the amount is huge, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined."
Article 12. Article 199 of the Criminal Law is deleted.

Article 13. Article 237 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever forcibly commits an indecent act against another person or insults a woman by violence, coercion, or any other method shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention.
"Whoever commits the crime in the preceding paragraph by assembling people or in a public place, or under other despicable circumstances, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years.
"Whoever commits an indecent act against a child shall be given a heavier punishment in accordance with the provisions of the preceding two paragraphs."

Article 14. Paragraph 2 of Article 239 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever, having committed the crime in the preceding paragraph, kills the kidnapped person, or intentionally injures the kidnapped person, causing serious injury or death, shall be sentenced to life imprisonment or the death penalty, and shall also have property confiscated."

Article 15. Paragraph 6 of Article 241 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever buys an abducted woman or child, if he or she does not maltreat the bought child and does not obstruct the rescue of the child, may be given a lighter punishment; if, in accordance with the wishes of the bought woman, he or she does not obstruct the woman's return to her original place of residence, may be given a lighter or mitigated punishment."

Article 16. A paragraph is added to Article 246 of the Criminal Law as paragraph 3: "Where the conduct specified in paragraph 1 is committed through an information network, and the victim brings a complaint to the People's Court but truly has difficulty in providing evidence, the People's Court may request the public security organ to provide assistance."

Article 17. Article 253a of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever, in violation of the relevant provisions of the State, sells or provides citizens' personal information to others, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall be fined or shall be fined only; if the circumstances are especially serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined.
"Whoever, in violation of the relevant provisions of the State, sells or provides to others citizens' personal information obtained in the course of performing duties or providing services shall be given a heavier punishment in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
"Whoever unlawfully obtains citizens' personal information by theft or other methods shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 1.
"Where a unit commits the crimes described in the preceding three paragraphs, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible for the crime shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the respective paragraphs."

Article 18. Paragraph 3 of Article 260 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "The crime in paragraph 1 shall be handled only upon complaint, except where the victim is unable to bring a complaint due to incapacity, or is unable to bring a complaint due to coercion or intimidation."

Article 19. One article is added after Article 260 of the Criminal Law as Article 260a: "Any person who has a duty of guardianship or care over a minor, elderly person, sick person, disabled person, or the like, who maltreats the person under guardianship or care, if the circumstances are flagrant, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention.
"Where a unit commits the crime described in the preceding paragraph, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible for the crime shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
"If the conduct described in paragraph 1 also constitutes another crime, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions on the heavier punishment."

Article 20. Paragraph 1 of Article 267 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever forcibly seizes public or private property, if the amount is relatively large, or commits multiple acts of forcible seizure, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall be fined or shall be fined only; if the amount is huge or there are other serious circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined; if the amount is especially huge or there are other especially serious circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment, and shall also be fined or have property confiscated."

Article 21. A paragraph is added to Article 277 of the Criminal Law as paragraph 5: "Whoever violently attacks a People's Police officer who is lawfully performing his or her duties shall be given a heavier punishment in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 1."

Article 22. Article 280 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever forges, alters, buys or sells, or steals, forcibly seizes, or destroys the official documents, certificates, or seals of a State organ shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined.
"Whoever forges the seal of a company, enterprise, institution, or people's organization shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights, and shall also be fined.
"Whoever forges, alters, or buys or sells resident identity cards, passports, social security cards, or driver's licenses, which may be used to prove identity according to law, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined."

Article 23. One article is added after Article 280 of the Criminal Law as Article 280a: "Whoever, in any activity where identity documents are required to be provided in accordance with State regulations, uses forged or altered identity documents or steals and uses another person's resident identity card, passport, social security card, driver's license, or other documents that may be used to prove identity according to law, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to criminal detention or public surveillance, and shall be fined or shall be fined only.
"If the conduct described in the preceding paragraph also constitutes another crime, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions on the heavier punishment."

Article 24. Article 283 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever unlawfully produces or sells specialized espionage equipment or specialized eavesdropping or photographic surveillance equipment shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall be fined or shall be fined only; if the circumstances are serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined.
"Where a unit commits the crime described in the preceding paragraph, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible for the crime shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph."

Article 25. One article is added after Article 284 of the Criminal Law as Article 284a: "Whoever organizes cheating in a national examination prescribed by law shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall be fined or shall be fined only; if the circumstances are serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined.
"Whoever provides cheating equipment or other assistance to another person for committing the crime in the preceding paragraph shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
"Whoever unlawfully sells or provides to another person the test questions or answers of an examination specified in paragraph 1 for the purpose of allowing cheating in the examination shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 1.
"Whoever takes an examination specified in paragraph 1 in place of another person, or causes another person to take the examination in his or her place, shall be sentenced to criminal detention or public surveillance, and shall be fined or shall be fined only."

Article 26. A paragraph is added to Article 285 of the Criminal Law as paragraph 4: "Where a unit commits the crimes described in the preceding three paragraphs, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible for the crime shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the respective paragraphs."

Article 27. A paragraph is added to Article 286 of the Criminal Law as paragraph 4: "Where a unit commits the crimes described in the preceding three paragraphs, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible for the crime shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 1."

Article 29. Two articles are added after Article 287 of the Criminal Law as Articles 287a and 287b:
"Article 287a. Whoever commits any of the following acts by using an information network, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall be fined or shall be fined only:
"(1) setting up websites or communication groups for committing fraud, teaching methods of committing crimes, producing or selling prohibited articles or controlled articles, or other unlawful or criminal activities;
"(2) publishing information on the production or sale of narcotic drugs, firearms, obscene articles, or other prohibited or controlled articles, or other unlawful or criminal information;
"(3) publishing information for committing fraud or other unlawful or criminal activities.
"Where a unit commits the crime described in the preceding paragraph, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible for the crime shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 1.
"If the conduct described in the preceding two paragraphs also constitutes another crime, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions on the heavier punishment.
"Article 287b. Whoever knowingly provides technical support such as Internet access, server hosting, network storage, or communication transmission, or provides assistance such as advertising promotion or payment settlement, for a crime committed by another person using an information network, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall be fined or shall be fined only.
"Where a unit commits the crime described in the preceding paragraph, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible for the crime shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 1.
"If the conduct described in the preceding two paragraphs also constitutes another crime, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions on the heavier punishment."

Article 30. Paragraph 1 of Article 288 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever, in violation of State regulations, knowingly sets up or uses a radio station (or radio transceiver station) without authorization, or uses radio frequencies without authorization, thereby interfering with the order of radio communications, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall be fined or shall be fined only; if the circumstances are especially serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined."

Article 31. Paragraph 1 of Article 290 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Where a crowd is gathered to disturb public order, if the circumstances are serious, causing work, production, business, teaching, scientific research, or medical care to be impossible, and causing serious losses, the ringleader shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years; other active participants shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights."
Two paragraphs are added as paragraphs 3 and 4: "Whoever repeatedly disturbs the work order of a State organ, and fails to correct after being subjected to administrative penalty, causing serious consequences, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance.
"Whoever repeatedly organizes or finances others to gather illegally to disturb public order, if the circumstances are serious, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph."

Article 32. A paragraph is added to Article 291a of the Criminal Law as paragraph 2: "Whoever fabricates false information about dangerous situations, epidemic situations, disaster situations, or police situations, and spreads such information on an information network or other media, or knowingly spreads the above false information on an information network or other media, thereby seriously disturbing public order, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance; if serious consequences are caused, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years."

Article 33. Article 300 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever organizes or uses superstitious sects, cult organizations, or uses superstition to undermine the implementation of the laws or administrative regulations of the State shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are especially serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than seven years or life imprisonment, and shall also be fined or have property confiscated; if the circumstances are relatively minor, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights, and shall be fined or shall be fined only.
"Whoever organizes or uses superstitious sects, cult organizations, or uses superstition to deceive others, causing serious injury or death, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
"Whoever commits the crime in paragraph 1 and also commits the crime of rape of a woman, fraud for property, or other crimes shall be punished in accordance with the provisions on combined punishment for several crimes."

Article 34. Article 302 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever steals, insults, or intentionally destroys a corpse, skeleton, or bone ash shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance."

Article 35. One article is added after Article 307 of the Criminal Law as Article 307a: "Whoever initiates a civil action based on fabricated facts, thereby disrupting judicial order or seriously infringing upon the lawful rights and interests of others, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall be fined or shall be fined only; if the circumstances are serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined.
"Where a unit commits the crime described in the preceding paragraph, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible for the crime shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
"If the conduct described in paragraph 1 illegally occupies the property of another person or evades lawful debts, and also constitutes another crime, the offender shall be convicted and given a heavier punishment in accordance with the provisions on the heavier punishment.
"Where a judicial officer, by taking advantage of his or her duties, jointly commits the acts described in the preceding three paragraphs with another person, a heavier punishment shall be imposed; if the conduct also constitutes another crime, the offender shall be convicted and given a heavier punishment in accordance with the provisions on the heavier punishment."

Article 36. One article is added after Article 308 of the Criminal Law as Article 308a: "Any judicial officer, defender, litigation agent, or other participant in proceedings who divulges information that should not be disclosed in cases that are not heard in public according to law, thereby causing the information to be publicly disseminated or causing other serious consequences, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall be fined or shall be fined only.
"If the conduct described in the preceding paragraph divulges State secrets, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Article 398 of this Law.
"Whoever publicly discloses or reports the case information described in paragraph 1, if the circumstances are serious, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 1.
"Where a unit commits the crime described in the preceding paragraph, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible for the crime shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 1."

Article 38. Article 311 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever, knowing that another person has committed crimes of espionage, terrorism, or extremism, refuses to provide relevant information when the judicial authorities investigate the relevant circumstances or collect relevant evidence, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance."

Article 39. Article 313 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever has the ability to enforce a judgment or ruling of a People's Court but refuses to do so, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or a fine; if the circumstances are especially serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined.
"Where a unit commits the crime described in the preceding paragraph, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible for the crime shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph."

Article 40. Article 322 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever illegally crosses the national border (or border) in violation of the regulations on border administration, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than one year, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall also be fined; if the offender illegally crosses the national border (or border) for the purpose of joining a terrorist organization, receiving terrorist training, or committing terrorist activities, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than one year but not more than three years, and shall also be fined."

Article 41. Paragraphs 1 and 2 of Article 350 of the Criminal Law are amended as: "Whoever, in violation of State regulations, unlawfully produces, sells, or transports acetic anhydride, ether, chloroform, or other raw materials or ingredients used in the manufacture of narcotic drugs, or carries the above substances into or out of the national border, if the circumstances are relatively serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are especially serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than seven years, and shall also be fined or have property confiscated.
"Whoever, knowing that another person is manufacturing narcotic drugs, produces, sells, or transports the substances specified in the preceding paragraph for that person shall be punished as an accomplice in the crime of manufacturing narcotic drugs."

Article 42. Article 358 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever organizes or compels another person to engage in prostitution shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment, and shall also be fined or have property confiscated.
"Whoever organizes or compels a minor to engage in prostitution shall be given a heavier punishment in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.
"Whoever commits the crime described in the preceding two paragraphs and also commits the crimes of homicide, injury, rape, kidnapping, or the like shall be punished in accordance with the provisions on combined punishment for several crimes.
"Whoever recruits or transports persons for a person who organizes prostitution, or otherwise assists another person in organizing prostitution, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined."
Article 43. Paragraph 2 of Article 360 of the Criminal Law is deleted.

Article 44. Article 383 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "For the crime of embezzlement, the offender shall be punished, based on the seriousness of the circumstances, in accordance with the following provisions:
"(1) If the amount embezzled is relatively large or there are other relatively serious circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined.
"(2) If the amount embezzled is huge or there are other serious circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined or have property confiscated.
"(3) If the amount embezzled is especially huge or there are other especially serious circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment, and shall also be fined or have property confiscated; if the amount is especially huge and the interests of the State and the people have suffered especially heavy losses, the offender shall be sentenced to life imprisonment or the death penalty, and shall also have property confiscated.
"Where there have been multiple acts of embezzlement that have not been dealt with, the offender shall be punished according to the cumulative amount of the embezzlement.
"If a person who has committed the crime described in paragraph 1 truthfully confesses his or her crime, sincerely repents, actively returns the illicit gains, and avoids or reduces the occurrence of harmful consequences before a public prosecution is initiated, if the circumstances fall under item (1), the punishment may be lighter, mitigated, or waived; if the circumstances fall under item (2) or (3), the punishment may be lighter.
"If a person who has committed the crime described in paragraph 1 is sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve under the circumstances specified in item (3), the People's Court may, based on the circumstances of the crime and other factors, at the same time decide that after the person's death sentence with a two-year reprieve is commuted to life imprisonment according to law upon the expiration of the two-year period, the person shall be imprisoned for life without commutation or parole."

Article 45. Article 390 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "For the crime of offering bribes, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined; if the offender seeks illegitimate benefits through bribery, and the circumstances are serious, or if State interests suffer major losses, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are especially serious, or if State interests suffer especially heavy losses, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment, and shall also be fined or have property confiscated.
"If the bribe-giver voluntarily confesses the bribery before being prosecuted, the punishment may be lighter or mitigated. If the crime is relatively minor, or if the bribe-giver plays a key role in solving a major case or has performed major meritorious service, the punishment may be mitigated or waived."

Article 46. One article is added after Article 390 of the Criminal Law as Article 390a: "Whoever, for the purpose of seeking illegitimate benefits, offers bribes to a close relative of a State functionary, or to a person who is otherwise closely related to such State functionary, or to a former State functionary or a close relative thereof, or to a person who is otherwise closely related to such former State functionary, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, or if State interests suffer major losses, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are especially serious, or if State interests suffer especially heavy losses, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than seven years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined.
"Where a unit commits the crime described in the preceding paragraph, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible for the crime shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined."

Article 47. Paragraph 1 of Article 391 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever, for the purpose of seeking illegitimate benefits, gives property to a State organ, a State-owned company, enterprise, institution, or people's organization, or in economic exchanges, in violation of State regulations, gives kickbacks or service fees in various names, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined."

Article 48. Paragraph 1 of Article 392 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever introduces a bribe to a State functionary, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined."

Article 49. Article 393 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Where a unit offers bribes for the purpose of seeking illegitimate benefits, or in violation of State regulations, gives kickbacks or service fees to a State functionary, if the circumstances are serious, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible for the crime shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined. If the illegal gains obtained through bribery are owned individually, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Articles 389 and 390 of this Law."

Article 50. Article 426 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever, by means of violence or threat, obstructs a commander or a person on duty or on guard from performing his or her duties shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention; if the circumstances are serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years; if the circumstances are especially serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment. During wartime, a heavier punishment shall be imposed."

51. Article 433 of the Criminal Law is amended as: "Whoever, during wartime, spreads rumors to confuse the masses and shake the morale of the armed forces shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years; if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years; if the circumstances are especially serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment."
52. This Amendment shall come into force on November 1, 2015.
